description: Codly server console: read-only stats, container list and log tails. Parameters are pattern-locked so no arbitrary command can be injected.

runCommand: A='{{ action }}'; T='{{ target }}'; N='{{ lines }}'; F='{{ filter }}'
flt() { if [ "$F" = errors ]; then grep -i -E 'error|exception|traceback|critical|fatal' | tail -n "$N"; else cat; fi; }
if [ "$F" = errors ]; then SCAN=$((N * 20)); else SCAN=$N; fi
echo '@@docker'; command -v docker >/dev/null && docker stats --no-stream --format json 2>/dev/null | head -60
command -v docker >/dev/null && docker ps -a --format json 2>/dev/null | head -80
docker inspect "$T" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "No container named $T on this host."; exit 3; }
case "$T" in *.log) ;; *) echo 'Only .log files are allowed.'; exit 3;; esac
[ -f "$P" ] || { echo "No log file $P on this host."; exit 3; }
